body.statement: For every sequence in \(\mathcal P_n\), including sequences with \(H\to\infty\), \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau=-L+o_{\mathbb P}(s)\), \(\widehat V/s^2\to_{\mathbb P}1\), and the primitive conditional block-dependence and score-diffuseness conditions yield \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P\{(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau)/\sqrt{\widehat V}\le z\mid M,\Omega\}-\Phi(z)|\to0\). Consequently, \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\mathbb P_P\{\tau\in\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\mid M,\Omega\}\to1-\alpha\). This strictly extends Choi and Yuan (2024), Theorem 3.1, for the same native subgroup estimator from \(q=0,H=1\) to fixed \(q\ge1\), growing \(H\), and a feasible nonzero curvature correction.
body.justification: The derived dependency-graph limit and feasible studentization convert weak-signal deterministic-MNAR completion into implementable inference for a sustained causal effect.
body.gap: Choi and Yuan cover a one-date independent-noise subgroup average; Cen and Lam cover residual HAC for loading scores; Su, Wang, and Wang cover regression coefficients from alternating maximization.
body.consumer: The confidence interval directly supports a reanalysis of the SEC Tick Size Pilot's average sustained liquidity effect over the realized treated cohort and post window.

obligation.what_is_open: The native expansion, feasible curvature rate, and relative fitted-weight rate needed before the proved score limit can be studentized.
obligation.obstruction: The causal cancellation, variance comparison, and conditional Gaussian limit are now closed, but the theorem still depends on the unresolved native second-order transfer target. Claiming coverage without that estimator-specific bridge would treat its hard conclusion as an assumption.
obligation.attempted: The exact causal error identity and banded-Toeplitz variance bound were combined with the now-proved conditional score central limit theorem. This reduces every remaining term to a conclusion stated, but not yet proved, in the native-transfer theorem.
obligation.partial_result:
The conditional score central limit theorem is proved in this dispatch.  The causal and studentization reductions are exact.  Consistency and the common-start mask give \(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}_{it}=Y_{it}(1)\) on \(G\times W\), hence
\[
 \widehat\tau-\tau
 =-\frac1{gH}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it}).
\]
If the native second-order target is established, the definitions of the correction and remainder then give
\[
 \widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}-\tau
 =-L-(Q-B_2)-R_{\mathrm{agg}}+(\widehat B_2-B_2)
 =-L+o_{\mathbb P}(s).
\]

For variance estimation, put \(d=\widehat w-w\), and let \(\Gamma_q\) and \(\widehat\Gamma_q\) be the banded Toeplitz matrices generated by \(\gamma\) and \(\widehat\gamma\).  Fixed \(q\), the conditional moment bound, and \(\Delta_\gamma=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) give bounded operator norms and
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 |\widehat V-s^2|
 &\le \|\widehat\Gamma_q\|_{\mathrm{op}}
       \left(2\|w\|_F\|d\|_F+\|d\|_F^2\right)
       +\|\widehat\Gamma_q-\Gamma_q\|_{\mathrm{op}}\|w\|_F^2\\
 &\le C_q\left\{
   \|w\|_F\|d\|_F+\|d\|_F^2+\Delta_\gamma\|w\|_F^2
 \right\}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Score diffuseness gives \(\|w\|_F^2=O(s^2)\).  Thus the fitted-weight conclusion of the native target and \(\Delta_\gamma=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) imply \(\widehat V/s^2\to_{\mathbb P}1\).  Conditional Slutsky applied to the now-proved score limit then yields the stated studentized limit and Wald coverage.  Therefore the only unclosed premise for this theorem is the native second-order transfer and its plug-in conclusions.
